items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: I knew Louis over 40 years. ... I actually met Louis here in New Orleans

ctx.x: I knew Louis over 40 years. I hadn't been a professional musician to him before I met Louis. I'd go back in the old days. I'd say in the late, in the early 30s, or late 20s. I actually met Louis here in New Orleans when he came to Sublimbore. I'd say I had a chance to listen to his records way back when he first started recording the Hot Five. I didn't know Louis when he was a place here. They left and they were in different places, California, Louis and Chicago. Kenora and all of them. That's the area I came to…
Louis Hardin Armstrong played piano in the group. Yeah, King Oliver and all that.

But I had a chance to meet all those guys in late years. And Louis came here. The Wicked Suburban Guard. I think it was... Excuse me, where was the Suburban Guard? Right in the Sandspot, right now. Out there on the Jefferson Highway.
